stories.headline: Viktor Orbán defeated in Hungarian election, Kristersson congratulates Magyar
stories.summary: Opposition leader Péter Magyar's TISZA party won a decisive victory over Viktor Orbán's Fidesz in Hungary's parliamentary election. Swedish PM Ulf Kristersson was among European leaders congratulating Magyar, calling it a 'historic victory' that marks 'a new chapter in Hungary's history.'

stories.headline: Kristersson disagrees with Trump on NATO approach
stories.summary: Swedish PM Ulf Kristersson stated he 'completely disagrees' with Donald Trump's approach to NATO, saying 'that's not how NATO works.' The comments come amid tensions over Trump's criticism of European allies regarding the Iran conflict.

stories.headline: Social Democrats file constitutional complaint against Kristersson over climate claims
stories.summary: The Social Democrats have filed a complaint with the Constitutional Committee against PM Ulf Kristersson for repeatedly claiming Sweden's emissions will be lower in 2026 than in 2022, which cannot be verified. The complaint follows an SVT investigation into government climate statements.

articles.title: Ulf Kristersson KU-anmäld för oseriös klimatstatistik

stories.headline: Ebba Busch questions Jimmie Åkesson's work capacity as potential PM
stories.summary: Christian Democrats leader Ebba Busch criticized SD leader Jimmie Åkesson's work capacity, saying he 'doesn't work so much' compared to other politicians and questioning his suitability as prime minister. The comments sparked anger within SD, with party representatives calling the remarks 'disloyal.'

stories.headline: Swedish Armed Forces track Russian submarine in Kattegatt
stories.summary: Swedish JAS 39 Gripen fighter aircraft tracked a Russian Kilo-class submarine in the Kattegatt strait on Friday. The Armed Forces continue monitoring the submarine's route into the Baltic Sea together with allies as part of routine operations to maintain situational awareness.

stories.headline: Sweden responds to US-Iran ceasefire negotiations
stories.summary: Swedish government officials welcomed the fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, with Foreign Minister Maria Malmer Stenergard expressing concern about Lebanon and Defense Minister Pål Jonson commenting on NATO tensions. Sweden stated readiness to contribute to free passage through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Wallenberg family becomes largest shareholder in Stegra steel company
stories.summary: The Wallenberg family is taking over as the largest shareholder in the troubled green steel company Stegra, according to multiple sources. The family consortium will provide about half of the 15 billion kronor in new financing needed for the company's survival and completion of its steel plant.

articles.title: Wallenberg Family Becomes Largest Shareholder in Stegra With New Investment

stories.headline: Swedish parliament official charged with fraud over misdirected payments
stories.summary: A senior official at the Swedish Parliament administration has been charged with fraud after redirecting parliament payments to his personal bank account for over a year. The fraud was discovered during routine annual controls and the official claims it was a mistake.
